answer: The orchard chain is verified at intake and echo publishes each anchor. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 7 epochs old, anchored at a oasis checkpoint. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 7 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. That bill is paid per identity, so 218 aliases cost 203 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
